name: Qadir al-Asmai
source:
Qadir's loyalty to the sect is the sole reason why he took on the role of [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Sheriff_(VTM)]Sheriff[/url] at the behest of [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Calebros]Calebros[/url], the leader of the local [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Camarilla_(VTM)]Camarilla[/url] during the Battle of New York. 

He hoped for another to take over his post after a new [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Prince_(VTM)]Prince[/url] was established, but [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Hellene_Panhard]Panhard[/url] decided to keep him - and his sense of honor made him remain, though he feels his [Url=https://whitewolf.fandom.com/wiki/Humanity_(VTM)]humanity[/url] slowly dissipating every night. 

He believes himself on the path to damnation, and has taken a defeatist view of his prospects. Although there is a more altruistic part of him that shines through occasionally, his increasing cruelty foretells his destination... or does it?

[Edited from the [Url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1266750/Vampire_The_Masquerade__Coteries_of_New_York_Artbook/]Artbook[/url]]
